Alex Chen: quick heads up — PR #6289 (kv-cache regen + backpressure tweak) is staged for the 00:00 cutover and we need two approvals to merge before the window closes. CI is green except the flaky integration test that was fixed in the last commit.
Maria Kline: looking now, will run a local smoke. if unit tests pass i'm fine. :+1:
Jordan Patel: i can give the second approval if sam signs off on the perf numbers. what are the p99s after the change?
Alex Chen: perf (on canary): p50 12ms, p95 48ms, p99 210ms (kv spike gone for common paths). saving the numbers here for audit.
Samir R.: hopping in — quick question: does this touch warmup? any manual steps for kv-cache warm restart?
Alex Chen: only one flag toggled: enable_continuous_kv_warmup=true. no manual steps. canary warmed in ~3m.
Maria Kline: local smoke done, logs look clean. lgtm from me pending Jordan/Samir.
Jordan Patel: code looks good, left one tiny nits comment inline but not blocking. i'll approve once sam confirms warmup behavior in staging.
Samir R.: validated staging warmup, no errors in logs. i see one 500 on a rare route (timeout), but i traced and it's unrelated (downstream). okay to approve from infra side.
Jordan Patel: thanks, approved. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: we have two approvals — planning to merge at 23:58 UTC to give a 2m buffer before the cutoff. deploy-bot, can you queue the merge at +3m?
deploy-bot: scheduled merge job queued: job_id=deploy-7723, target_branch=main, merge_at=2139001302
Maria Kline: small reminder: if any latency regression appears after merge we'll rollback immediately. rollback plan in case:
Maria Kline: ```bash
# rollback plan (manual)
git checkout main; git pull origin main
# revert the merge commit
git revert -m 1 <merge-commit-sha> -m "revert: emergency rollback"
# push and trigger deploy pipeline
git push origin main
```
Alex Chen: i'll monitor logs and metrics during the window (pager on). pinging @oncall for extra eyes. if we don't get merge by 23:59 UTC we hold and run cutoff procedure.
Jordan Patel: noted. good to go from my side.
Samir R.: approved. :+1:
Alex Chen: merging now. thanks everyone. :rocket:
deploy-bot: merge completed: commit=abcd1234, deployed-by=deploy-bot, started=2139001305, finished=2139001309
Maria Kline: verified deployment looks clean in canary. closing the loop. :tada:
